title: Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-24B-A2B: A 2B-Active MoE for On-Device Agents
summary: Liquid AI released LFM2.5-24B-A2B, an open-weight 24B Mixture-of-Experts reasoning model with 2B active parameters. It targets local agents, scoring 48.09 on LiveClaw and decoding 184 tokens/s on an Apple M5 Max. The post Liquid AI Releases LFM2.5-24B-A2B: A 2B-Active MoE for On-Device Agents appeared first on MarkTechPost .
